info.title: Budget Go Finance, Workbench & Account API
info.description: Exact integer-poisha BDT finance, manual asset/debt positions, dated valuations, reversible transfer matching, staged CSV/reconciliation, deliberate rules, planning and Bangladesh alert inbox. V4 workspace is authoritative; historical V3 rejects states it cannot represent. Planning and automation remain at their V3 URLs and share the same revision. No FX, live prices, background rule posting or external bank access. Profile/security/full backup are browser-session-only and unavailable through bearer/MCP.

post.summary: Mutate financial/classification data, valuations or transfer matching
post.description: Requires finance:write. Read the latest shared revision. A new command needs a fresh requestId. After an unknown result, replay the exact envelope; changed request IDs can duplicate deliberate operations. Stale new commands return409; reload, review and explicitly resubmit. Cookie POSTs require matching Origin; bearer never falls back to cookies. Eleven manual BDT account families use signed positions: negative owed, positive assets or overpaid debt. Adjustments are dated deltas neutral to income/spending. Matching preserves both settlement dates and retains original entries for unmatch; matched transfers cannot be deleted directly.

post.summary: Save/apply a rule or stage/commit/reconcile statement rows
post.description: finance:write. Read the latest shared revision. A new command needs a fresh requestId. After an unknown result, replay the exact envelope; changed request IDs can duplicate deliberate operations. Stale new commands return409; reload, review and explicitly resubmit. Cookie POSTs require matching Origin; bearer never falls back to cookies. Staging never posts money. Explicit commit imports up to100 selected rows or links existing same-account/date/direction/amount transactions. Duplicate candidates require explicit per-row includeDuplicateRowIds acknowledgement; duplicateIds lists existing entries and duplicateRowIds lists earlier same-statement rows. Reconciliation records reported closing balance and difference without creating balancing money. Rule apply rechecks matching selected IDs and commits classification changes plus run audit atomically. No background rule execution.

post.summary: Change password or invalidate all sessions and integration tokens
post.description: Browser session only; current password required. password_change requires12–256 nonblank characters. Both actions increment session version, invalidating current/other browser sessions and all old integration tokens; sign in again. Failed passwords are rate limited to5 attempts per15 minutes. No requestId receipt: if response is lost and session is rejected, sign in to determine outcome; do not describe this as replayable financial mutation.

post.summary: Deliberately replace current owner's supported data from validated backup
post.description: Browser session and current password required. Read the latest shared revision. A new command needs a fresh requestId. After an unknown result, replay the exact envelope; changed request IDs can duplicate deliberate operations. Stale new commands return409; reload, review and explicitly resubmit. Cookie POSTs require matching Origin; bearer never falls back to cookies. Destructive owner-scoped replacement is atomic and rolls back on invalid references/domain invariants or ID collision. Preserve current name/email/password, sessions/tokens and existing request receipts as replay tombstones; do not import backup auth. UI requires reviewed counts and typed RESTORE before calling. Backend enforces password, ownership, revision and validation; typed confirmation is a UI interaction, not a request field. Wrong password is rejected. This is an application backup, not infrastructure disaster recovery.

200.description: Replacement committed or exact restore receipt replayed.
